name: Flutter Mane
description: This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a certain book.

moves.name: Confuse Ray
moves.description: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that causes confusion.

moves.name: Spite
moves.description: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.

moves.name: Astonish
moves.description: The user attacks the target by crying out in a startling fashion. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Psybeam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Mean Look
moves.description: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.

moves.name: Memento
moves.description: The user faints. In return, the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats are harshly lowered.

moves.name: Wish
moves.description: One turn after this move is used, the user's or its replacement's HP is restored by up to half the user's max HP.

moves.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.description: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Mystical Fire
moves.description: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Power Gem
moves.description: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

moves.name: Psyshock
moves.description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.

moves.name: Phantom Force
moves.description: The user vanishes somewhere, then strikes the target on the next turn. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

moves.name: Pain Split
moves.description: The user adds its HP to the target's HP, then equally splits the combined HP between the target and itself.

moves.name: Moonblast
moves.description: Borrowing the power of the moon, the user attacks the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Perish Song
moves.description: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.

moves.name: Psybeam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Night Shade
moves.description: The user makes the target see a frightening mirage. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.

moves.name: Confuse Ray
moves.description: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that causes confusion.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.

moves.name: Spite
moves.description: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon's Speed stats.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.

moves.name: Charm
moves.description: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: The user randomly uses one of the moves it knows. This move can only be used while the user is asleep.

moves.name: Pain Split
moves.description: The user adds its HP to the target's HP, then equally splits the combined HP between the target and itself.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type attacks. The sunlight also lowers the power of Water-type attacks.

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally's attack.

moves.name: Imprison
moves.description: If opposing Pokémon know any move also known by the user, they are prevented from using it.

moves.name: Hyper Voice
moves.description: The user attacks by letting loose a horribly loud, resounding cry.

moves.name: Fake Tears
moves.description: The user feigns crying to fluster the target. This harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Magical Leaf
moves.description: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to boost its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Dark Pulse
moves.description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with ill intent. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Power Gem
moves.description: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Trick Room
moves.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

moves.name: Charge Beam
moves.description: The user attacks the target with an electric charge. The residual electricity may also boost the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Psyshock
moves.description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.

moves.name: Stored Power
moves.description: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Hex
moves.description: This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status conditions.

moves.name: Phantom Force
moves.description: The user vanishes somewhere, then strikes the target on the next turn. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

moves.name: Disarming Voice
moves.description: Letting out a charming cry, the user does emotional damage to opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Draining Kiss
moves.description: The user steals the target's HP with a kiss. The user's HP is restored by over half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Misty Terrain
moves.description: This protects Pokémon on the ground from status conditions and halves damage from Dragon-type moves for five turns.

moves.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.description: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

moves.name: Poltergeist
moves.description: The user attacks by controlling the target's item. This move fails if the target isn't holding an item.

moves.name: Tera Blast
moves.description: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type attacks. The sunlight also lowers the power of Water-type attacks.
